k_ads_A = 0.49915358563126583

k_LH = 4.0136582491408754
adsorption_A = k_ads_A*a_concentration
adsorption_B = k_ads_B*b_concentration
relaxation_trace = adsorption_A + k_des_A + adsorption_B + k_des_B
relaxation_determinant = adsorption_A*k_des_B + k_des_A*adsorption_B + k_des_A*k_des_B
relaxation_gap = sqrt(relaxation_trace^2 - 4*relaxation_determinant)
relaxation_slow = (relaxation_trace - relaxation_gap)/2
relaxation_fast = (relaxation_trace + relaxation_gap)/2
A_equilibrium = adsorption_A*k_des_B/relaxation_determinant
B_equilibrium = k_des_A*adsorption_B/relaxation_determinant
A_slow = (adsorption_A - relaxation_fast*A_equilibrium)/relaxation_gap
B_slow = (adsorption_B - relaxation_fast*B_equilibrium)/relaxation_gap
A_fast = -A_equilibrium - A_slow
B_fast = -B_equilibrium - B_slow
AB_surface = A_equilibrium*B_equilibrium + (A_equilibrium*B_slow + B_equilibrium*A_slow)*laplace_rate/(laplace_rate + relaxation_slow) + (A_equilibrium*B_fast + B_equilibrium*A_fast)*laplace_rate/(laplace_rate + relaxation_fast) + A_slow*B_slow*laplace_rate/(laplace_rate + 2*relaxation_slow) + (A_slow*B_fast + A_fast*B_slow)*laplace_rate/(laplace_rate + relaxation_slow + relaxation_fast) + A_fast*B_fast*laplace_rate/(laplace_rate + 2*relaxation_fast)
response = k_LH*AB_surface
